table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
	date        = dbo.saleledger.date,
	patientcode = Max(dbo.saleledger.patientcode),
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	dbo.customer.cp, 
	dbo.customer.address1, 
	dbo.customer.address2,
	dbo.customer.city,
	netamount = 
			Round(
			SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + 
					saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0)
			+
			Round(
			SUM( (saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.bonusqty) * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * 
						  (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
						  (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				 ROUND( (SUM((saledetail.looseqty * 
						(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
						(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) -
						saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0),
	regno = dbo.Patient.RegNo,
	patientname = Patient.name,
	Rank = (Select dbo.rank.name From dbo.Patient, dbo.Rank Where dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode AND dbo.patient.rankcode = dbo.rank.rankcode),
	Relation    = (Select dbo.relation.name From dbo.Relation Where dbo.saleledger.relationcode = dbo.relation.relationcode),
	Unit = (Select dbo.unit.name From dbo.Patient, dbo.Unit Where dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode AND dbo.patient.unitcode = dbo.unit.unitcode),
	doctor = (Select d.name From Doctors D Where dbo.saleledger.doctcode = D.DoctCode)
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saledetail,   
	dbo.accounts, 
	dbo.customer,
	dbo.Patient	
WHERE 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and  
	dbo.saleledger.date Between :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate and
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and
	dbo.saleledger.custcode  = :al_CustCode and 
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and	
	dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.saleledger.custcode and
	dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode
GROUP BY 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
	dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
	dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
	dbo.saleledger.patientcode,
	dbo.saleledger.doctcode,   	
	dbo.Patient.RegNo,
	dbo.Patient.Name,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	 
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.relationcode,
	dbo.accounts.name,	
	dbo.customer.cp,
	dbo.customer.address1,
	dbo.customer.address2,
	dbo.customer.city
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
	date        = dbo.saleledger.date,
	patientcode = Max(dbo.saleledger.patientcode),
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	dbo.customer.cp, 
	dbo.customer.address1,
	dbo.customer.address2,
	dbo.customer.city,
	netamount = 
			Round(
			SUM((sd.looseqty*(sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + 
					saleledger.misccharges + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0)
			+
			Round(
			SUM( (sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty) * sd.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (sd.looseqty * 
						  (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc)) *
						  (1 - (.01 * sd.discperc)) * sd.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				 ROUND( (SUM((sd.looseqty * 
						(sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc)) *
						(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) -
						saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0),
	regno = dbo.Patient.RegNo,
	patientname = Patient.name,
	Rank = (Select dbo.rank.name From dbo.Patient, dbo.Rank Where dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode AND dbo.patient.rankcode = dbo.rank.rankcode),
	Relation    = (Select dbo.relation.name From dbo.Relation Where dbo.saleledger.relationcode = dbo.relation.relationcode),
	Unit = (Select dbo.unit.name From dbo.Patient, dbo.Unit Where dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode AND dbo.patient.unitcode = dbo.unit.unitcode),
	doctor = (Select d.name From Doctors D Where dbo.saleledger.doctcode = D.DoctCode)
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saleinvdetail sd,   
	dbo.accounts, 
	dbo.customer,
	dbo.Patient	
WHERE 
	DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' AND 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and  
	dbo.saleledger.date Between :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate and
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and
	dbo.saleledger.custcode  = :al_CustCode and 
	dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and	
	dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.saleledger.custcode and
	dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode
GROUP BY 
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
	dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
	dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
	dbo.saleledger.patientcode,
	dbo.saleledger.doctcode,   	
	dbo.Patient.RegNo,
	dbo.Patient.Name,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	 
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.relationcode,
	dbo.accounts.name,	
	dbo.customer.cp,
	dbo.customer.address1,
	dbo.customer.address2,
	dbo.customer.city
